title: Publicly Traded Debt Restructuring Methods, Corporate Investment, and Debt Contracting
eligible_reason: Single event date: aft = 1 if year > 2014 (code.do line 556, 'treatment date Dec 2014', Marblegate v. EMC ruling) for every firm; treat = distressed firms affected by the ruling. Table 4-5 investment DiDs (reghdfe capex_diff_w treat##aft l_roa_w l_size_w l_lev_w if distress==1, absorb(gvkey qdate)) have one adoption cohort and lagged time-varying controls; Table 6 bond-issue regressions use more_than_10##aft with industry/rating/quarter FE and issue controls. Not staggered.
